status: RESEARCH-ONLY SOURCE OPEN-SET VALIDATION FAILED FOR SAFETY PROMOTION
source_origin: UCI Machine Learning Repository, gas sensor array low-concentration; 90 original exposures, 6 gas identities, 3 concentration levels x5 original replicates
source_sensor_layout: ten 900-sample contiguous blocks per exposure, reshaping equivalent (10,900).T
experiment: for each mode and test-unknown gas and known withheld source ppb level, known train gases are the other FOUR, negative calibration gas is a FIFTH gas, and sealed negative test gas the SIXTH different gas
source_feature_model: ClassicalLearningV6.SoftmaxModel 4 known gas classes, 800 iterations, learning rate 0.15, L2 0.005, train-only standardization; FULL candidate vector preserved
threshold: fit on 8 known-calibration source exposures plus 15 calibration-negative from a different unknown gas; maximize half sum known retention and unknown rejection, tie bias toward more abstention; no test data used
source_hypothesis_survival: All four known class scores recorded even if reported as UNKNOWN; open-set score is not a calibrated posterior, original candidate retained
external_source_findings: Full ten-source array has high known closed-set accuracy (178/216=82.41%) but poor UNKNOWN rejection (119/270=44.07%), which means 151/270=55.93% unknowns were incorrectly accepted as known.
MQ135 alone unknown rejection was 174/270=64.44% with 96/270=35.56% false-known acceptance; lower closed-set known accuracy and severe known abstention remain.
These rates do not qualify for field gas identity or safety warnings. A model cannot be promoted for Tank from source-only score calibration.

Calibration-only threshold depends on identity of an alternate unknown gas; different unknown classes generalize poorly. Full array improves known-source recognition but not necessarily open-set rejection.
Repeat source folds share source gas categories, electronics and possibly acquisition day across folds; independent device/day Tank evidence is absent.
limitations: Original UCI source device/day/session grouping not proved; unknown test identity separated from negative calibration identity only within fold.
All model scoring is external source research and no physical Tank gas-reference, Rs/R0 calibration, source traceability or safety-grade unknown rejection validation has been done.
This source-only threshold must never be applied to installed Tank gas identity without G3.
The official original UCI array does not match Tank electronics in channel set or device characteristics.
Food freshness remains a separate independent module; no food profile joins gas ChemCore.
